sections.heading: Context: why pre-season friendlies matter
sections.text: Friendly matches on international tours serve multiple purposes for elite clubs such as Chelsea and Juventus. They offer coaching staff the opportunity to assess squad fitness, try tactical variations, and integrate new signings or youth prospects in a lower-stakes environment than competitive league or cup matches. Tours to regions like Hong Kong also allow clubs to connect with global fanbases and deliver live football to supporters away from Europe. While results are secondary to preparation during these fixtures, eye-catching moments — like Zhegrova’s notable strike — can provide confidence boosts for the scoring side and talking points for fans and pundits alike.
